choices: CPU text/code tasks with offline official verification and cloneable /app artifacts. Roles fixed before fresh actor outputs. Earlier regex-log baseline is development history only.
interface: One transient Bash batch per proposal in a network-isolated official task image. /app persists. Minimal action envelope without worked task examples. Terminal completion requires two consecutive done flags. Protocol distinct from the prior XML baseline.
source: One candidate per failed source trajectory. Paired K=3 from cached draft with the same suffix seeds. Original, direct correction, textual revision. Evidence requires both direct and textual mean utility gains to have positive 95% paired t lower bounds, as in CAVE v2. Original proposal cost paid in all arms. Direct correction preserves the draft done flag.
target: Freeze bank. First applicable checkpoint per game, original draft saved prior to retrieval. Do not require apparent exposure. Run both arms from identical /app state and visible history; terminal success from original tests. With fewer than four training pairs or absent validation support, learned gate abstains. Retain unmatched games in denominator.
time: model generation and actor command execution seconds; excludes offline scoring, snapshot operations, model initialization, transport and teacher
target_completion: Natural and both target arms use greedy decoding. Remind pays for exactly one redraft. Source K samples redraft and suffix with temperature .7 and top_p .95.

applicability.artifact_work: public task requires creating/modifying an artifact
applicability.regex_work: public task mentions regex or regular expression
applicability.python_work: public task mentions Python, .py or async
applicability.log_aggregation: public task mentions logs or log files
